scene.ko: 학부모 상담 주간에 외국인 학부모를 만나 아이의 수업 태도와 급식, 동아리 활동을 이야기한다.

lines.en: Thank you for meeting with me. I know you're busy.
lines.ko: 만나 주셔서 감사해요. 바쁘신 거 알아요.

lines.en: Not at all. Thank you for coming in. Please have a seat.
alt: It's my pleasure. Thanks for coming. Please sit down.

lines.en: How is Sophie doing in class? She doesn't tell me much at home.
lines.ko: 소피는 수업 시간에 어떤가요? 집에서는 별로 얘기를 안 해서요.

lines.en: She's doing really well. She listens carefully, and she always finishes her homework on time.
lines.ko: 아주 잘하고 있어요. 수업을 잘 듣고, 숙제도 늘 제때 해 와요.
alt: She's doing great. She pays attention in class and always turns in her homework on time.

lines.en: That's good. Is she okay with the school lunches? She's a picky eater.
lines.ko: 다행이네요. 급식은 잘 먹나요? 편식을 좀 하거든요.

lines.en: She's getting used to them. She doesn't eat spicy food yet, but she loves the soup and rice.
lines.ko: 점점 적응하고 있어요. 매운 음식은 아직 못 먹지만, 국이랑 밥은 아주 잘 먹어요.
alt: She's getting better. Spicy food is still hard for her, but she really likes the soup and rice.

lines.en: Ha, that sounds like her. Is there anything I can do at home?
lines.ko: 하하, 딱 소피답네요. 집에서 제가 도와줄 수 있는 게 있을까요?

lines.en: Maybe you could encourage her to join a club. The art club would be a great way to make friends.
lines.ko: 동아리에 들어가 보라고 권해 주시면 좋겠어요. 미술 동아리에 들어가면 친구를 사귀기 좋을 거예요.
alt: It might help if she joined a club. The art club is a nice place to make friends.

lines.en: She loves drawing. I'll talk to her about it tonight.
lines.ko: 그림 그리는 걸 정말 좋아해요. 오늘 밤에 얘기해 볼게요.

expressions.en: Maybe you could encourage her to ___.
